7cd478fb5f769755.sentence: In sub-Saharan Africa, pupils with developmental disabilities are described as remaining mostly unschooled, often excluded from mainstream education and facing barriers to enrolment in special schools, which are usually few, expensive, located in the capital and low in capacity [4].

7cd478fb5f769755.span: Schools, when offering sufficient assistance, can be ideal platforms for such services, also ensuring that caring responsibilities are not placed exclusively on families ( Uba & Nwoga, 2016 ).
